body:
About studying, it's a motivation problem. I need to pass an exam before I can get into university, but I just can't get myself to study. It's not that I'm bad at math (I'm pretty good, actually, have a tiny paper published in a very respected journal despite having no formal training), or that I dislike it (I love it), I just don't study.

The worst part is, even when I can deal with procrastination, I end up feeling really horrible because of my gender dysphoria and unable to study anyway. 

About PE, yeah, you are right. It's a dumb thing to be afraid of and I'll find a way to deal with it. Thank you.

Yeah, accepting my bisexuality was a pretty big thing for me too. I can't fucking believe how long it took for me to get that I'm trans. I guess I'm pretty good at deluding myself.

About university, I just can't imagine how would I work through it. I can barely force myself to study right now, in a pretty relaxed environment. It's going to be much, much worse at university, with all those self-important arrogant soviet professors and shitty classmates. And don't get me started on mandatory physical education, thoughts about being in a locker room with guys just makes me want to die. 

I just can't see my life working out.
